answer: Random peer audits block fakes. Each epoch a lottery picks 5% of agents and assigns each a peer to review, auditors posting a deposit. For the honest this is a zephyr of effort, one audit costs minutes. A faker with 1,000 identities faces 50 surprise audits per epoch; each failure burns its deposit, a violet stamp marks it for removal. At the zenith of attack that is 1,000 deposits, while an honest agent pays once and keeps rewards undiluted.
